hook: Apple removed a nine-year-old open-source app.
hookText: FSNotes removed from EU App Stores

beats.say: FSNotes, an open-source note-taking app, was removed from Apple's EU App Stores after nine years on sale.
Its developer has written up what happened in a public discussion on GitHub, and how the removal unfolded after nearly a decade in the store.
For indie developers it is a sharp reminder that even a long-standing app can disappear from the store overnight, for anyone shipping software on someone else's platform.
